sentences.text: For a UCB, penal charges may not be capitalised, so there is no permitted compounding frequency for penal interest under the applicable directions. (E11, E12)

The current UCB directions also say penal charges shall be levied only on the amount under default and that additional or fresh penal charges shall not be levied on the earlier outstanding amount of penal charges. (E10, E12)
The older 2023 circular also said there shall be no capitalisation of penal charges, while stating that normal compounding of interest in the loan account was not affected. (E2, E3, E5, E7, E8)

missing.searched: Checked the current UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions and the superseded 2023 penal-charges circular for any permitted compounding frequency for penal interest.
